points: Google Cloud release notes dated August 18, 2026 establish the new 15 GB minimum for GKE node pools on version 1.36.3-gke.1480000 and later.
G1 first screen had no Google native component or AI Overview completing the migration.
G2 read both pages: results are older boot-disk Q&A, general disk resizing, node-pool migration guides and unrelated GKE migrations; no strong exact-task cluster.

G3 pass: Portworx gives one full add-new-pool/drain/delete workflow, but other visible pages concern generic resizing or unrelated migrations; fewer than two stable exact-task implementations address the new 15 GB change.
